routes.title: Approval routes
routes.description: Who must approve each kind of document, step by step from top to bottom. A step can apply only when a condition is true, can have a time limit, and can pass to someone else when the time runs out. A new version applies only to requests raised after it is activated; requests already running finish on the version they started with.
